<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Brutal Crush](/Feats.aspx?ID=5399) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Barbarian" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=18" />
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 56

**Prerequisites**

**Requirements**
Your last action dealt bludgeoning damage using an [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) Strike granted by a [morph](/Traits.aspx?ID=657) or [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect.

</column>

---

You've learned how to cloud your foes' minds with the brutal impact of your repeated attacks. Make an unarmed Strike against the same target. If the Strike hits and deals bludgeoning damage, the target is [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) for 1 round (stupefied 3 on a critical hit).
